messages:
ara: Heads up — bringing up the new quantized model `q4-small-8bit` on the synthesis-control promptset and seeing a weird token-level metric drop vs fp32. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/1234 :eyes:

sam: Which metrics and which run id?

ara: run id `eval/2026-03-12/3672`. Token-PPL +0.12, token-BLEU down ~3 points. Full logs attached to the run. Quick suspicious line in the runner logs: `WARNING: fixture cache mismatch: key...`

devon: Did we change any fixture generation recently? Synthetic augmentations can shift distributions if seeding changed.

ara: We did switch augmentation to use `np.random.default_rng()` a couple weeks ago. I didn't pin fixture_seed in the generator. Snippet:
```python
# fixtures/augment.py
- rng = np.random.default_rng()
+ rng = np.random.default_rng(fixture_seed)
```

sam: Ah — so eval fixtures produced for baseline runs might differ from what the eval runner is using now. Could explain drift for quantized runs if tokenization/caching combined with augment change.

ara: Also noticed the runner caches tokenized fixtures under `/tmp/eval-cache/<key>.tok`. The cache key currently includes model name and promptset but not quantization profile or augmentation seed. That's probably the leak.

lee: @ara can you add augmentation seed to fixture metadata and include quantization profile in cache key?

ara: Yep. Quick local patch:
```diff
diff --git a/eval_runner/cache.py b/eval_runner/cache.py
@@
- key = f"{model_name}:{promptset}:{fixture_id}"
+ key = f"{model_name}:{quant_profile}:{promptset}:{fixture_id}:{augment_seed}"
```
I'll push and run tests.

eval-bot: CI run queued: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/987 (tests: tests/eval_runner/test_cache.py) :warning:

devon: Also add a unit test to ensure cache key changes when quant_profile flips. Something like `test_cache_key_includes_quant_and_seed`. Right now we only assert model+promptset.

sam: And we should add a regression assert in the eval harness for token-PPL delta vs baseline (small tolerance). If quantization legitimately changes distribution, that should still surface as an evaluated regression alert rather than silent metric drift.

ara: Good call. I'll add `assert abs(baseline.token_ppl - current.token_ppl) < 0.05` to the smoke eval for release gating.

lee: Also update the fixture creation CLI so teams can pass `--seed` to make synthetic fixtures deterministic for reproducibility.

ara: Pushed PR 5478: https://git.redwood.ai/r/5478 — includes: seed param for fixture generator, cache key fix, unit tests, and a CI job to run quantized runner cache tests. PTAL. :thumbsup:

devon: Running the patched local eval now. Early signal: q4-small-8bit token-BLEU matches fp32 within noise (delta < 0.5%).

sam: Nice. Once CI passes, schedule a full re-run comparing q4 vs fp32 across the benchmark suite. If gap persists, roll back quantize profile or adjust kernel selection.

eval-bot: nightly eval scheduled for 2026-03-13T02:00:00Z (run id planned: eval/2026-03-13/4001).

ara: Thanks everyone — closing the loop here. Will post final numbers after the overnight run. :white_check_mark:

sam: Great catch — saved us from a subtle leakage. :tada:
